storage_policy.notes: Raw datasets and downloaded archives stay outside Git under .artifacts. Review license and privacy risk before promoting any excerpt into fixtures.

sources.name: Korea FTC standard terms board
sources.license_notes: Public government board. Treat attachments as source material for private research until redistribution rights are reviewed.

sources.name: Korea Consumer Agency standard consultation answers
sources.license_notes: Public Data Portal file page. The page states file downloads are available without login; verify license terms before redistribution.

sources.name: Korea FTC consumer civil complaint model consultation cases
sources.license_notes: Public Data Portal file page. Useful as cancellation/refund guidance rather than terms text.

sources.name: OPP-115 privacy policy corpus
sources.license_notes: UsablePrivacy research corpus. Review non-commercial/research restrictions before redistribution.

sources.name: MAPP mobile app privacy preferences corpus
sources.license_notes: Related mobile privacy corpus. Review license before redistribution.

sources.name: FSDK privacy-related SDK dataset
sources.license_notes: Supporting privacy dataset, not a terms corpus. Keep separate from terms corpus ingestion.

sources.name: OPP-115 GDPR aligned annotations
sources.license_notes: Privacy law corpus derived from OPP-115. Review license before redistribution.

sources.name: Opt-out Choice 2020 dataset
sources.license_notes: Choice and opt-out dataset. Review license before redistribution.

sources.name: APP-350 Android app privacy policy corpus
sources.license_notes: Annotated Android app privacy policies. Review license before redistribution.

sources.name: MAPS policies dataset
sources.license_notes: Large URL index of mobile app privacy policies. Use as crawl seed after legal and robots review.

sources.name: Opt-out Choice 2017 dataset
sources.license_notes: Older opt-out choice dataset. Review license before redistribution.

sources.name: ACL/COLING 2014 privacy policy corpus
sources.license_notes: Older annotated privacy policy corpus and paper supplement. Review license before redistribution.

sources.name: PrivacyQA corpus
sources.license_notes: Public GitHub repository. Review repository license before redistribution.

sources.name: ToS;DR terms of service corpus mirror
sources.license_notes: Public GitHub repository. Kaggle variant may require account/API token.

sources.name: ToS;DR API documentation and legacy JSON index notes
sources.license_notes: Legacy JSON index documentation is public, but the old services index URL currently returns 404. Use the Zenodo raw dataset source for current bulk data.

sources.name: ToS;DR policies dataset raw CSV snapshot
sources.license_notes: Zenodo record 15012282 is public and lists GPL-3.0-or-later. Its documents.csv contains policy text; keep raw CSV outside Git.

sources.name: Online Terms of Service unfair clause dataset
sources.license_notes: Public Hugging Face dataset. Multilingual ToS unfair clause data from CLAUDETTE-style corpus.

sources.name: Open Terms Archive dataset directory
sources.license_notes: Public dataset directory and GitHub org metadata. Full collection cloning is deferred to targeted source selection.

sources.name: Princeton-Leuven Longitudinal Corpus of Privacy Policies
sources.license_notes: Public research corpus. Full 1M+ policy collection is large; collect metadata first, then mirror targeted subsets.

sources.name: CLAUDETTE corpora directory
sources.license_notes: Public corpus directory. Dataset files may be mirrored via Hugging Face or specific corpus links after license review.

sources.name: AI Hub legal/regulation text analysis data
sources.license_notes: Likely requires AI Hub login, agreement, and download procedure. User should collect or authorize separately.

sources.name: Kaggle ToS;DR terms of service corpus
sources.license_notes: Requires Kaggle account/API token. Use public GitHub mirror first.

sources.name: Common Crawl and Internet Archive policy snapshots
sources.license_notes: Public web-scale archive. Collection must be targeted by domain and time range to avoid unnecessary bulk mirroring.
